# Angel Portuondo — angelito91.github.io

> Portfolio of Angel Alberto Portuondo Hierrezuelo: Full Stack & game developer,
> founder of QvaLabs, Computer Science student at Universidad de Oriente
> (Santiago de Cuba).

## Who is Angel?

- Full Stack Developer (2+ years): Astro, React, Svelte, TypeScript, Node.js, Tailwind CSS.
- Game Developer: Unreal Engine 5 (C++, Blueprints) and Godot (GDScript).
- Tools & systems: Rust, Python, C++, Linux, Git, Cloudflare, Bun.
- Founder of **QvaLabs**: software, automation, AI and infrastructure for businesses.
- Game & web developer at **Xitry Games** (Unreal Engine + official studio website).
- Languages: Spanish (native), English (intermediate B1).

## Selected work

- **8Apera Fotografía** (2026) — Professional website for a photography studio in
  Santiago de Cuba. Astro, Tailwind CSS, GSAP. https://8apera.com
- **8Apera Blog** (2026) — Documentary blog with headless Keystatic CMS.
  Astro, React, Keystatic, Cloudflare. https://blog.8apera.com
- **Xitry Games** (2026) — Trilingual corporate site for an indie game/3D studio.
  Astro, Tailwind CSS, Splide, Cloudflare. https://xitry-game.com
- **Halo Compiler** (2026) — Educational compiler/interpreter in Rust (lexing,
  parsing, AST, type checking). https://github.com/Angelito91/halo
- More repositories: https://github.com/Angelito91?tab=repositories
